issue.title: Invoice PDF shows due date one day early on the Chicago server
issue.body:
Invoice issued 2024-03-01 with 30 day terms should be due 2024-03-31. The PDFs generated on our Chicago server say 2024-03-30. On my laptop in Berlin the same invoice says 2024-03-31, and the unit test passes on CI. Same commit everywhere.

It isn't always off: some invoices are right on the server too, I haven't found the pattern. I suspect the day arithmetic when crossing a month boundary, since March has 31 days.

Node 20.

commits.message: Add date parsing and formatting helpers

files.README.md:
# invoicer

Builds invoice summaries for the billing service.

Dates on invoices are calendar dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`) and are handled in UTC.

commits.message: Add invoice summary with due date

expected.cause: formatDate in src/format.js reads the date with local-time getters (getFullYear/getMonth/getDate) although dates are held as midnight UTC, so in time zones behind UTC the formatted day is the previous one.

notes: Cross-file: symptom in invoice.js dueDateLabel, cause in format.js. Reporter blames month-boundary arithmetic (wrong). dates.js and the README both state UTC handling, so the doc is right and the formatter is the outlier.
